WITH event_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e.status,
        AVG(b.remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG((b.spent - b.amount) * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM budget AS b
    JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
    GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status
),
status_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        status,
        AVG(avg_remaining) AS avg_remaining,
        AVG(avg_overspend_rate) AS avg_overspend_rate
    FROM event_metrics
    GROUP BY status
)
SELECT
    status,
    avg_remaining,
    avg_overspend_rate,
    avg_remaining / NULLIF(AVG(avg_remaining) OVER (), 0) AS remaining_vs_status_mean
FROM status_metrics;

assumptions.assumption: A zero budget amount makes the overspend rate undefined; NULLIF excludes such lines from the overspend-rate averages. SQL AVG ignores NULL values, including missing remaining or rate values.
